page.title: Traffic analytics
page.subtitle: Observed HTTP traffic, separated by server source.
loadFailed: Could not load traffic observations. Retry to fetch a new snapshot.
empty: No observations for this source and range. Missing observations are not zero traffic.
trend.note: Autoscaled: only the latest contiguous observations are plotted; unknown buckets break the trend.
trend.awaiting: Not enough contiguous observations to plot.
bytes.coverage: Bytes measured for {known} of {total} requests; totals include only known bytes.
map.title: Observed countries
map.label: Country traffic map. Use the country selector or ranking for equivalent keyboard access.
map.legend: Request intensity: logarithmic scale, relative to the largest observed country.
map.credit: Made with Natural Earth · public domain · local 110m boundaries
map.limit: Small territories may not appear at this scale. Every observed country remains in the ranking. Boundaries do not imply sovereignty or network paths.
map.responsesNote: Responses equal observed requests with an HTTP status; requests without an observed status are not included.
map.flows.failure: Tint: error share; dashed: errors exceed successes. Select a country for exact counts.
map.flows.sameCountry: Requests from the service country: {count}. Ring size shows their relative volume on a logarithmic scale.
map.flows.note: Flows are logical client-country → service-location access observations, not physical network routes. Client location is an offline-CIDR estimate, not a precise position. Countries without a map shape remain in the ranking but have no arc.
map.flows.unconfigured: Access flows are not drawn because the service location is not configured (traffic_analytics.site_country).
map.flows.noShape: Access flows are not drawn because the configured service country has no shape at this map scale.
routes.title: Observed access categories / services
routes.note: These are observed HTTP categories, not traceroute hops. HTTP 4xx/5xx errors do not identify geographic network faults.
coverage.title: Coverage, privacy and retention
coverage.source: Sources are independent: never add backend and frontend counts or visitor estimates together.
coverage.backend: Backend ASGI observations exclude traffic ingest and aggregate reads.
coverage.frontend: Frontend SvelteKit server observations only. SPA client navigations and static CDN delivery are not measured. HTML pageviews are successful GET server responses, not all browser views.
coverage.proxy: Client addresses require explicitly verified adapter / reverse-proxy trust. Without it, addresses are unknown. Visitor-supplied address and geo headers are not trusted. Proxies, VPNs and offline CIDR gaps can leave requests unlocated or locate the egress instead of the user.
coverage.privacy: No analytics cookies, browser fingerprinting or geo headers. Raw IP addresses are used temporarily for offline lookup and rotating unique estimates, not retained in traffic aggregates. URLs, queries, cookies, user agents and user content are not analytics dimensions.
coverage.retention: Aggregate retention: {days} days. Longer selected windows may have incomplete coverage.
coverage.unlocated: Unlocated: {count} of {total} observed requests. Unknown location is not no traffic.
coverage.bytes: Byte observations are application stream bytes, not wire or compressed transport sizes. Frontend request bytes stay unknown because the reporter never consumes request bodies; cancelled / errored response streams have unknown bytes.
coverage.latency: Latency is observed server duration, not geographic network RTT or end-user page load time.
coverage.freshness: Available means aggregate retrieval succeeded, not complete ingress coverage or a connected reporter. Compare the source’s last observed event with the snapshot time; no event timestamp means no observed source activity. Edge/CDN traffic is not observed.
unique.coverage: Usable visitor identity for {known} of {total} requests. Unique visitors are estimates of IP identities, not people; missing identities are excluded.
coverage.partial: This snapshot has incomplete coverage. Known values are observations, not estimates of missing traffic.
